function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or live data feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now.
message.reasoning: User asks "紐約市現在是幾點？" meaning "What time is it now in New York City?" We need to provide the current time. We can use the function to get the current weather forecast? But we need time. There's no function for time. We could approximate using weather forecast? No. We might have to answer with an estimate or say we don't know. But maybe we can call the function with location "New York City" and hour=0? That returns weather forecast, not time. So we can't get time via function. We should respond that we cannot determine the exact current time. But we can approximate based on UTC offset. But better to say we don't have real-time data. So answer: I don't have real-time capability.
